events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: John Cleese is 87 today! From 'The Dead Parrot Sketch' to Basil Fawlty, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that broke all the rules. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: 35 years. Still the greatest showman. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His voice lives on forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Classic Album
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A masterpiece that saw them evolve into true studio innovators. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon, whose message of peace and love continues to resonate. He would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie turns 80
events.blurb: The iconic 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie 80
angles.copy: The legend would have been 80 today. From Ziggy Stardust to The Thin White Duke, David Bowie's influence is truly immeasurable. What's your favourite era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King Forever
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music, his moves, his legacy – unmatched. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the riff master, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his influence on rock is monumental. What's his greatest guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The gravel-voiced rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Still rocking at 82! Happy Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. A career spanning decades, what's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the original Nutty Boy, Suggs from Madness! What's your favourite track from the kings of Camden?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the smooth voice of the 80s, Paul Young! What's your favourite track from the blue-eyed soul sensation?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend and cultural icon Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday today. She passed away on August 25, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music and spirit continue to inspire. What's your favourite Dolly song?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the man behind so many hits, Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo work, his songwriting is pure class.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean, known for global hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Simply Awesome
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get into My Car' is still a banger. What's your favourite?

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: The first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in '86, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who's the first artist you'd put in?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got those dance moves. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: 58 years ago today, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their final live show. An iconic moment in music history. What's your favourite track from that legendary set?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the drumming legend, Phil Collins! From Genesis to his solo mega-hits, his impact is undeniable. What's your favourite?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the 'Prince of Pop', Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. What's your favourite of his unforgettable characters?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', a tragic plane crash in 1959 that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Never Forgotten
angles.copy: 68 years ago, music lost three stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'. Their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop sensation and internet meme legend Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on his classic hits. What's your favourite?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: One love, one heart. The legendary Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music and message of unity are timeless. What's your favourite Marley track?

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King, known for 'Tapestry' and countless hits for other artists, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Tapestry Tales
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting powerhouse who gave us 'Tapestry' and so much more. What's your favourite of her compositions?
